title: Bind observations and record feedback
scenario: Scenario: task-feedback / workflow-map. Candidate based on main 48b854b, captured 2026-10-18. Use Python 3.11+ with a disposable home and synthetic project. Default installations collect nothing.

steps.title: Find the task commands
steps.instruction: Open docs/map/workflow.html. Under Self-improvement and eval, open Private observations and expand its details. Follow Sources to account/observation/README.md for the command contract.
steps.caption: Actual map dialog. Task selections and feedback exist; Codex collection and case export remain planned in this slice.
steps.expected: Use task-bind to freeze exact events or an inclusive receipt range. Use feedback-add for a symptom and correction, and task-show to inspect the private revision.

steps.title: Select, review and revoke
steps.instruction: Grant a disposable synthetic project and import events from two sessions. Bind only the intended events, repeat the request to check idempotency, then add feedback and inspect task-show. Reject unselected evidence. Revoke the grant when finished.
steps.caption: Selected output from the actual CLI smoke, rendered in a browser. This is not a terminal capture or native/model qualification.
steps.expected: The exact selection stays frozen. Retry returns duplicate; unselected evidence is rejected. After revoke, task-show returns disabled and private task/feedback records are removed.
